title: Vertical World(not a finał name)– Early prototype, looking for feedback
author: Ok_Butterfly_2901
selftext:
Hey, I've been working on a little survivors-like game in my free time.

It's called Vertical World. The idea is to mix Vampire Survivors-style gameplay with an RPG class system, where you can change jobs, unlock skills and fight different bosses.

It's still very early in development, so there's a lot of stuff missing or unfinished, and probably plenty of bugs.

I figured I'd share what I have so far and see what people think.

You can try it here: [https://shotari1-arch.itch.io/vertical-world](https://shotari1-arch.itch.io/vertical-world) 

Let me know what you think, especially if something feels off or just isn't fun.

  
Use of AI: I use AI to help me with coding in Godot, but mostly to build custom tools for creating sprites, VFX, maps and other game assets. I handle the game design and decide what actually makes it into the game.
